doc.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Own band and New York period
title: Max Roach's So What brass quintet
summary: He confirms about 1998 to 2000 with Max Roach's group and says there were few gigs.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: It says that you then started touring with Max Roach’s So What brass quintet. I didn’t see you until 2000 with that group. So that must have been an extended tenure with him.
It seemed like it was between ’98 to 2000.
That’s what I believe too. Again, we’re trying to correct the historical record.
Right. We didn’t have so many gigs. We did a number of things.
